title: Development work for promotion of tourism at Kavaratti Lighthouse, Kavaratti Island, UT of Lakshadweep
summary: Two-cover e-tender for tourism development works at Kavaratti Lighthouse, Kavaratti Island, Lakshadweep, under the Cochin Directorate.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Gandhinagar, Kadavanthra P.O., Cochin

sites.name: Kavaratti Lighthouse, UT of Lakshadweep, Kavaratti-682555
sites.work: Development work for promotion of tourism

scope.item: Development work for promotion of tourism at Kavaratti Lighthouse

money.notes: Tender fee Nil. EMD by DD/FDR from any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Cochin, payable at Ernakulam; originals of EMD (or MSME/UDYAM/NSIC certificate) with technical documents to be submitted physically. Bid Securing Declaration also required.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous bodies; OR, for contractors from Lakshadweep group of islands, work experience with any Government department in island works during last 07 years
Similar works completed in last 7 years: three >= 40%, two >= 50% or one >= 80% of estimated cost

Similar works: construction of roof sheet truss work of multistorey building, solar frame truss work, waterproofing work, construction of residential/institutional/office buildings/lighthouse tower or related civil construction works
PAN and GST registration; CA-certified turnover of last three years
Declaration that bid is unconditional; affidavit on Rs 100 stamp paper of not being blacklisted; undertaking listing relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL
EPF/labour registration certificate; tender acceptance letter; bid securing declaration

corrigenda.change: Corrigendum-III: bid submission extended to 11.11.2025 15:00, submission of EMD/technical documents in original to 10.11.2025 15:00, technical bid opening to 12.11.2025 15:00. Other terms unchanged.

documents.file: Corrigendum-III Development Work For Promotion of Tourism at Kavaratti Lighthouse Kavaratti Island UT of Lakshadweep.pdf

notes: NIT is Section I only (printed pages 2-4), no BOQ or detailed scope of the tourism works. Original NIT dates: download/submission 24.09.2025 (18:00) to 08.10.2025 (15:00), bid query last date 29.09.2025, EMD original by 07.10.2025, opening 09.10.2025; dates above reflect Corrigendum-III. Corrigenda I and II are not among the documents. NIT spells 'Kavarati Lighthouse' in the name of work.
